implementation: Canonical editable circle/square scene with local color, size, position, bounce, speed, freeze and center commands. No code inference for supported local commands. Unsupported commands or modified sources use existing model path. No Keep requirement before next ask.
unitTests: 32 sequential edits, exact expected properties, 3840 simulated frames across two sizes, one version per ask and undo all 32 passed. Unsupported/modified inputs and bounds tested.
browserTests: 32 local edits with undo/replay each passed, zero inference requests, next voice ask enabled. Painted acknowledgements mocked. Existing generation/refinement/cancellation regressions passed.

phoneRun.scope: Local text ask to painted frame on physical iPhone. Speech and provider latency excluded. Every move checked properties, one version, undo/replay, paint, and three screenshots.
phoneRun.visualReview: All 96 screenshot frames inspected in review.png: expected color, size and position changes visible; frozen frames stable and bouncing frames vary. Sparse captures do not prove frame-by-frame continuity.

limitations: Supported unchanged canonical scenes only; other requests use code generation.
Live edits still reload source, but build 21 shares motion state in memory.
normalMode: Build 21 relaunched with all fixtures disabled and tested local scene promoted to normal ledger. Controls, preview runtime, and painted checkpoint confirmed. Rope scene remains in its separate sequence ledger.

phasePreservation.unitTests: Shared runtime store preserves phase across color/size/speed edits and undo. Freeze retains current height; a new scene starts independently.
phasePreservation.phoneValidation: All 32 moves passed with stateful motion source, including freeze and resume. Exact phase continuity tested with shared-store module reloads in focused tests; phone snapshots are sparse motion evidence.

previousPhoneRun.scope: Local text ask to first painted frame; physical iPhone. Excludes speech and model latency. One version, undo/replay and properties verified for every move; 96 screenshots retained.
previousPhoneRun.visualReview: All 96 frames inspected in review.png contact sheet; colors, sizes and position changes visible. Three-frame samples are not continuous motion recordings.
